build.fileTranscription: native timed owner connected; native screen interaction not verified
build.preferences: native isolated setup/presentation restoration connected; real-user migration and native UI not verified
build.workspace: macOS panel, isolated preferences, native scan/open/export connected; native UI not verified

word-merger.scope: Finite word inputs: committed/display/suffix/since snapshots, exact times/confidence/text/UUID identity, held word, watermark and duplicate counters; not full transcript grouping or UI

transcript-store.scope: Finite transcript inputs plus 1566 fixture word payloads (not full stdout replay): exact line/word identity, text bytes, times/confidence, grouping, speaker fixes/numbers, overlap, edits, translation provenance, suppression, reload/reset and explicit display delivery. No wall-clock scheduling, UI pixels, translation generation or archive serialization.

transcript-follow.scope: Pure state/action parity: live/static geometry, wheel intent, merge identity/time, unseen count, pill, reset and threshold boundaries. No native wheel/scrollbar events, layout or animation comparison.

archive.scope: Exact UTF-8 Markdown/plain export; reopened names, word times/confidence, translations and identity invariants. Fresh UUID values differ intentionally. Does not verify native UI, file writes, SRT/VTT/JSON export or invalid Swift-trapping numeric inputs.

archive-writer.scope: Real temporary files: pointer/error presence, canonical names and contents after checkpoint, reset, rename, summary and I/O failure. Live macOS compares full file bytes exactly; portable reference additionally compares filename-derived summary headings canonically, with body bytes exact. Error wording, cross-volume moves, crash durability and native UI are not compared. Concurrent allocation is verified separately in Rust.

export.scope: Finite supported numeric inputs: exact SRT/VTT UTF-8, cue float bits/text, complete JSON data including editor analysis, and upgrade-safe editor defaults. Live macOS also compares exact JSON formatting when speaker ordering is deterministic. Nondeterministic equal-duration speaker ordering is canonicalized. No native save dialogs or UI.

preferences.scope: Original Swift initializers and SwiftUI AppStorage getters, read-only native Foundation bridge, portable restoration, font buttons, response-speed floors and caption decoding/clamps. Volatile synthetic domains only. No original preferences changed; real-user migration and native UI NOT_RUN.

glossary.scope: Glossary storage, schema restoration and mutations only; no matcher, learning integration, persistent owner or Settings UI

personal-vocabulary.scope: Pure vocabulary learning/matching, display correction and prompt policy; native owner, file effects and UI remain separate

korean-numbers.scope: Counter formatting, repeated passes, Sino/native parsing and ambiguity guards; not rendered UI or inference accuracy.

text-passes.scope: Unchanged combined display pass and pre-translation stable scan with the original transcript store. Word/line identity, edits, target/cache/preview gates and reset; translation dispatch, clocks and UI excluded.

segmenter.scope: Exact PCM hashes, offset bits, body counts, speech flags, previews and flush/configuration transitions; not device capture, resampling, WAV IO, engine feeding or native UI acceptance.

capture-pipeline.scope: Shipping ingest/mix/pause/stop/abort, exact Float meter and callback order, WAV bytes/names, preview rotation, retained files and cleanup; no hardware, live engine or UI acceptance

live-config.scope: Live launch options, language candidates, multi-target window and preview settings; no engine, capture hardware or UI execution
live-config.intentionalDifference: Rust clears unset engine-owned keys and validates the canonical owned stream root

captureBridge.scope: In-process native resampler/callback ABI and Rust segmentation; no device or permissions
limitations: Device switch and permission denial NOT_RUN
No live engine or UI session is connected by this gate

records.captureHashScope: Native Swift comparison on the same CI host; AVAudioConverter result hashes are not assumed portable across OS versions

package.relocatedDecode: 16000 Hz mono PCM16, one second; original preserved
package.runtimeLayout: all four executables and seven assets resolved inside the relocated app
package.scope: Headless relocated package/runtime layout, decoder and native capture-to-owned-WAV replay; no UI, microphone, full model inference, model admission or updater validation
